purpose: Fixed comparison inputs and acceptance boundaries; not an executable SDK policy or a rendered demo

slot_bindings.workspaceId: Explicit active workspace selection; no router registration implied
slot_bindings.workspace: Trusted declared graph subtree of the existing product editor; same SDK session
slot_bindings.inspector: Trusted declared graph subtree of the corresponding inspector; same SDK selection
slot_bindings.queueSummaryLabel: Actual typed job state; no fabricated counts
slot_bindings.queueDetailsLabel: Actual typed job detail or explicit unsupported state

slot_contract.empty_semantics_status: Requested bounded ReactNode empty profile; Meari public contract and rejection evidence pending

identity_comparisons: Same slot placement and graph identity: preserve state/useId, editor input and callback ownership across scalar prop updates
Wide/narrow transition: preserve one inspector subtree; hidden is not disposal
Explicit replacement: revoke the old slot event export and reject stale events; retain unrelated shell state
Empty slot: no hidden replacement element, duplicate shell, fake editor or inferred first selection
Foreign owner, stale generation, cycles and excessive depth/node/byte budgets: bounded typed rejection

P1a: ReactNode named attributes and child projection
Bounded graph ownership and stable placement
P1b: Controlled nonmodal/modal, asChild, forceMount, hidden and focus semantics

sdk_baseline.reuse_scope: Existing proposal startup/frame/close/store and style/font evidence only; not shell visual acceptance
